name: White Lightning
body:
School evocation [cold, electricity]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a small piece of copper)

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.

Area 60-ft. line

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You release a powerful stroke of frigid electrical energy that deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to each creature within its area. The stroke begins at your fingertips.

Half the damage is electrical damage, and the other half is cold damage. If the damage caused to an interposing barrier shatters or breaks through it, the stroke may continue beyond the barrier if the spell’s range permits; otherwise, it stops at the barrier just as any other spell effect does.
